description: Backend-only round, designed for a sandboxed agent (Codex) that CANNOT bind localhost ports for browser QA - every story is verifiable by unit tests / curl / fixtures, NO browser. Two things: (A) fix the context-window meter's denominator to resolve from the model the system-init event REPORTS (claude runs fable-5 = 1M) instead of the launch model (undefined -> 200k); (B) build the image-input BACKEND seam for #1 image paste - an imageInput capability, AgentImageAttachment on the turn seam, server-side base64->per-provider staging, and driver plumbing (codex -i file path, claude stream-json image content block, grok --prompt-json or honest imageInput:false). The composer paste handler, transcript image rendering, retiring the paperclip, and the unified provider/model picker are a SEPARATE Claude follow-up round (they need automate-browser). This branch is cut from loop/conan-daily-driver (NOT yet merged to main) because it builds on that round's contextWindowFor/registry + attachments seam. Constraints: NO provider-name branching (ride AgentCapabilities); never claim a capability a provider lacks; never fabricate a number (unknown window -> null); UI mirror types via the type-only re-export from src/agent/driver.ts (import-free) so drift is a compile error; subscription auth only, never ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; paywall stays off, no gates. Source PRD: prd-conan-image-backend.md. NOTE: read CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md first. Run the gateway with `npm start` (NO watch - restart after ANY src/ edit). Gates: `npm run typecheck` AND `npm test` AND `cd ui && npm run build`. Keep probe prompts trivial and run in a temp dir, never the conan repo.

userStories.title: Context-window denominator resolves from the reported model, not the launch model
userStories.description: As a user, I want the context meter to use my session's REAL model window, so a Claude thread on fable-5 shows /1M instead of /200k.
acceptanceCriteria: The meter's denominator is currently `contextWindowFor(provider, launchModel)`; on a fresh claude thread launchModel is undefined -> registry 'default' = 200k, but claude actually runs claude-fable-5 (1M). Fix: resolve the window from the model the system-init event REPORTS (`e.model` in src/agent/index.ts), not the launch model

Get the corrected `contextWindowTokens` to the client - either refresh/re-send the capabilities frame after system-init, or add `contextWindowTokens` to the system event; whichever, the client must receive the value derived from the REPORTED model
An unknown reported model (not in the registry's CONTEXT_WINDOWS table) resolves to null - counts only, never a guessed denominator
No provider-name branching; codex (reports no usable model) and grok still behave correctly (grok reports a build name - keep it null-safe)
Unit test: `contextWindowFor('claude','claude-fable-5')` = 1_000_000 and the resolution path picks the reported model; a table-miss returns null
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Owner: CODEX (no browser). Standalone from the image work - do it first, it's the quick correct-the-meter win. The registry CONTEXT_WINDOWS table + contextWindowFor already exist (src/agent/registry.ts). Suggested skills: none.
